# Hospitals

This folder contains the Danish hospitals and regional health clusters evaluated in the national clinical quality databases for atrial fibrillation (AFDK). The pages detail each institution's performance against standardized clinical indicators—such as echocardiography completion, anticoagulation treatment coverage, TSH screening, and structured patient education—alongside severe outcome metrics like bleeding, stroke, and mortality. It also captures methodological nuances in the registry data, such as the consolidation of specific hospital units due to data allocation issues, and highlights local quality improvement initiatives like specialized AF clinics and group education programs.

## Pages

- [[aalborg-universitetshospital-thisted|Aalborg Universitetshospital Thisted]] — Department under Aalborg Universitetshospital evaluated for AF quality indicators, noting high long-term anticoagulation compliance.
- [[aalborg-universitetshospital|Aalborg Universitetshospital]] — Major hospital in Region Nordjylland tracked for AF treatment standards, including echocardiography and anticoagulation coverage.
- [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] — Major hospital in Region Midtjylland evaluated for AF clinical quality, including severe bleeding and one-year mortality outcomes.
- [[amager-og-hvidovre-hospital|Amager og Hvidovre Hospital]] — Healthcare institution in Region Hovedstaden assessed for AF indicators, showing mixed compliance with national standards for echocardiography and anticoagulation.
- [[bispebjerg-og-frederiksberg-hospitaler|Bispebjerg og Frederiksberg Hospitaler]] — Combined hospital organization in Region Hovedstaden evaluated for AF treatment metrics, notably falling short on echocardiography standards.
- [[bornholms-hospital|Bornholms Hospital]] — Healthcare organization in Region Sjælland meeting standards for initial AF treatment and showing high compliance for anticoagulation coverage.
- [[esbjerg-sygehus-grindsted-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]] — Composite reporting unit in Region Syddanmark evaluated for AF quality metrics, including echocardiography and treatment coverage.
- [[herlev-og-gentofte-hospital|Herlev og Gentofte Hospital]] — Major hospital in Region Hovedstaden tracked for AF indicators and recognized for its structured group education program for AF patients.
- [[holbaek|Holbæk]] — Refers to Holbæk Sygehus in Region Sjælland, evaluated for AF diagnostic and treatment indicators, including TSH measurement and anticoagulation.
- [[hospitalerne-i-nordsjaelland|Hospitalerne i Nordsjælland]] — Hospital group in the Capital Region assessed for AF quality indicators, performing strongly on TSH screening but narrowly missing long-term anticoagulation targets.
- [[hospitalsenhed-midt|Hospitalsenhed Midt]] — Hospital unit in Region Midtjylland meeting national AF standards and recognized for its interdisciplinary Atrial Fibrillation clinic established in 2012.
- [[hospitalsenheden-vest|Hospitalsenheden Vest]] — Administrative hospital unit in Region Midtjylland evaluated for AF anticoagulation treatment coverage and other clinical quality metrics.
- [[kolding-sygehus|Kolding Sygehus]] — Hospital in Region Syddanmark whose AF indicator data is methodologically consolidated with Vejle Sygehus under Sygehus Lillebælt.
- [[naestved-sygehus|Næstved Sygehus]] — Hospital in Region Sjælland that met the national standard for structured AF patient education, albeit with a very small patient cohort.
- [[nykoebing-falster|Nykøbing Falster]] — Refers to Nykøbing Falster Hospital in Region Sjælland, evaluated for AF echocardiography and anticoagulation treatment coverage.
- [[ouh-odense-universitetshospital|OUH Odense Universitetshospital]] — Major hospital in Region Syddanmark tracked for AF clinical outcomes, including ischemic stroke and intracranial bleeding rates.
- [[regionshospital-nordjylland-ven|Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven]] — Regional hospital in Region Nordjylland demonstrating strong performance in AF anticoagulation treatment coverage.
- [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] — Regional hospital in Region Midtjylland successfully meeting national standards for AF echocardiography and anticoagulation treatment.
- [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]] — Regional hospital in Region Midtjylland exceeding AF echocardiography standards and performing closely to targets for TSH screening.
- [[regionshospitalet-randers|Regionshospitalet Randers]] — Regional hospital in Region Midtjylland demonstrating strong compliance with national benchmarks for AF echocardiography and anticoagulation.
- [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] — Major hospital in Region Hovedstaden comprehensively evaluated for AF quality indicators, including severe bleeding, stroke, and mortality outcomes.
- [[samso-sundheds-og-akuthus|Samsø Sundheds og Akuthus]] — Small healthcare facility on Samsø with zero-result AF indicator data, used to illustrate statistical challenges with small patient populations.
- [[sjaellands-universitetshospital-koenge|Sjællands Universitetshospital Køge]] — Hospital in Region Sjælland evaluated for AF metrics, notably falling short on echocardiography standards but meeting initial treatment targets.
- [[sjaellands-universitetshospital-roskilde|Sjællands Universitetshospital Roskilde]] — Hospital in Region Sjælland that successfully met national standards for AF echocardiography and initial treatment indicators.
- [[slagelse-sygehus|Slagelse Sygehus]] — Hospital in Region Sjælland that met the standard for structured AF patient education, though evaluated on a very small patient cohort.
- [[steno-diabetes-center|Steno Diabetes Center]] — Specialized hospital tracked for AF outcomes, showing zero events for severe bleeding and mortality due to extremely low patient volumes in this demographic.
- [[sundhedsklyngen-slagelse|Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse]] — Healthcare cluster in Region Sjælland monitored for AF quality indicators, including anticoagulation initiation and geographic stroke incidence.
- [[sundhedsklyngen-suh|Sundhedsklyngen SUH]] — Health cluster associated with Sjællands Universitetshospital, tracked for AF treatment standards and recording the lowest proportion for structured patient education.
- [[sygehus-lillebaelt|Sygehus Lillebælt]] — Hospital organization in Region Syddanmark serving as a combined reporting entity for Kolding and Vejle Sygehus due to registry data allocation issues.
- [[sygehus-soenderjylland|Sygehus Sønderjylland]] — Hospital in Region Syddanmark meeting AF echocardiography standards, with noted data collection discrepancies regarding TSH measurement packages.
- [[vejle-sygehus|Vejle Sygehus]] — Hospital in Region Syddanmark whose AF performance data is consolidated with Kolding Sygehus under Sygehus Lillebælt due to registry distribution issues.
